module.particleeffects.desc: 在自己身上或世界固定位置编排多轮粒子组合，支持完整粒子列表、独立时序和三维编辑。
Compose independent particle rounds on your character or at world anchors, with the full particle registry, per-emitter timing and 3D editing.
setting.particleeffects.budget.hint: 包含发射器生成的子粒子；只限制本功能，达到预算后跳过本刻额外生成。
Includes children spawned by emitters. Only this feature is limited; excess emissions are skipped for that tick.
setting.particleeffects.guideBudget.hint: 只限制三维方框辅助标记，不改变实际粒子；优先显示选中的粒子。
Limits 3D guide boxes only, with selected emitters prioritized. Actual particles are unchanged.
ui.particles.title: 粒子特效编辑器
Particle Effects Studio
ui.particles.local: 本机视觉 · 关闭仅清理本功能创建的粒子 · 设置自动保存
Local visual effects · stopping removes only particles created here · edits save automatically
ui.particles.roundHint: 单轮反复循环；多轮按序循环；持续停留需手动切下一轮。
One round loops; multiple rounds cycle in order. Held rounds advance manually.
ui.particles.optionsPlaceholder: 简单粒子无需参数；复杂粒子使用下方模板
Simple types need no options; use a template for complex types
ui.particles.anchorValid: 固定点属于当前世界和维度
Anchor belongs to the current world and dimension
ui.particles.anchorElsewhere: 固定点属于其他世界或维度，本地不会绘制
Anchor belongs to another world or dimension and will not render here
ui.particles.mirrorHint: X/Y/Z 翻转对应坐标；组合可生成最多八个镜像位置。
X/Y/Z reflect the corresponding coordinates; combinations create up to eight mirrored positions.
ui.particles.angleHint: 角度旋转发射速度方向；原版面向相机的贴图保持原版朝向。
Angles rotate the emission velocity. Camera-facing vanilla sprites retain their original facing rules.
ui.particles.scaleHint: 缩放仅应用于原版四边形粒子；自定义几何和发射器保持原尺寸。
Scaling applies to vanilla quad particles. Custom geometry and emitters retain their native scale.
ui.particles.durationHint: 0 表示从开始时间持续到本轮结束；各粒子独立设置。
0 emits from its start until the round ends. Each emitter has its own timing.
ui.particles.lifetime: 单颗粒子寿命（秒，0 为原版）
ui.particles.lifetimeHint: 持续停留会持续补发。原版粒子可能因碰撞、介质或自身行为提前消失；切轮和结束停留会清理该轮粒子。
Held effects continually emit. Vanilla particles can expire early due to collisions, surroundings or native behavior. Round changes and emitter end times remove their particles.
ui.particles.selectHint: 选择一个粒子，或从列表添加新的粒子。
Select an emitter or add a new particle from the registry.
ui.particles.search: 搜索粒子 ID，例如 flame、dust、cherry
Search particle IDs, e.g. flame, dust, cherry
ui.particles.libraryHint: 完整注册表，包括带参数的类型；参数由原版解析，新增模组类型可自行填写 SNBT。
Full registry including parameterized types. Options use the vanilla parser; modded types accept editable SNBT.
ui.particles.invalidNumber: 请输入范围内的有效数字
Enter a valid number within the range
ui.particles.layoutHint: 此处预览位置与方向；真实粒子外观请点回世界预览。
Preview position and direction here; use World Preview for actual particles.
ui.particles.previewMouse: 拖点移动 · Alt 拖点转角度 · 空白左拖旋转 · 右拖平移 · 滚轮缩放
Drag points to move · Alt-drag to rotate · drag empty space to orbit · right-drag pan · wheel zoom
ui.particles.worldMouse: 点击方框选中并拖动 · Alt 拖动改角度 · 右拖观察 · 滚轮改尺寸
Select and drag markers · Alt-drag angles · right-drag view · wheel changes scale
ui.particles.worldExit: Esc 返回编辑器；粒子仍按本轮与组合设置播放。
Esc returns to the editor. Particles continue using the composition's round settings.
ui.particles.noProvider: 此类型没有可用的客户端粒子提供器
This type has no available client particle provider
ui.particles.noWorld: 请进入世界后验证粒子参数
Enter a world to validate particle options
ui.particles.loadFailed: 读取粒子方案失败；原文件保留，当前使用空方案。
Could not read the composition. The original file is retained; an empty composition is in use.
ui.particles.saveFailed: 粒子方案保存失败，请检查文件写入权限。
Could not save the composition; check file write permissions.
